incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated resident memory growth on paged-attn pool 'pa-usw2-3' (kv-cache) — nodes in autoset showing >85% GPU mem reserved, OOM risk. Samples: 6m delta +22%
lee (oncall): on it. pulling heap profiles and pid maps.
maria (engineer): any customer impact visible?
lee (oncall): not yet in SLO loss, a couple of 503s on a few replicas. ingress rate steady. tagging customers for watch.
sam (runtime): throwing a couple of CUDA OOM logs on serving-42: "GPU 0: out of memory while allocating KV slab"; also slab_alloc.warn spam.
lee (oncall): paste the tail logs pls
sam (runtime): ```
2026-03-17T02:11:02Z runtime ERROR serve::kv::alloc FailedAlloc: requested 64MiB, available 8MiB
2026-03-17T02:11:02Z runtime WARN slab: fragmentation_ratio=0.78 free_regions=123
2026-03-17T02:11:03Z cuda ERROR driver: CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH_OUT_OF_RESOURCES
```
infra-bot: detaching noncritical bump services from pa-usw2-3 pool to free capacity: job batch-infer-14 -> rescheduled to pa-usw2-7.
maria (engineer): can we trigger an immediate KV compaction sweep? We pushed a compaction knob in canary before but maybe it didn't hit live nodes.
sam (runtime): compaction endpoint exists: /admin/kv/compact?sweep=full. running on serving-42 now.
lee (oncall): running heap profile collection: rdwctl heapdump serving-42 > /tmp/heap-6630001111.hprof
ops-manager: notify support for customer-watch? Which customers on those replicas?
lee (oncall): customer mapping: acct-237, acct-88, acct-plat-batch. low % of requests for acct-237 returned 503s, ops notified.
lee (oncall): compaction return: "compaction started, estimated reclaim 300MB"
sam (runtime): compaction logs:
```
[admin] compaction: slab_scan=OK reclaimed=312MiB fragmented_regions=98 new_fragmentation=0.32
[admin] kv: rebalanced free lists
```
lee (oncall): memory sample after compaction: 6m delta now +6% (was +22%). good improvement but still trending upwards.
maria (engineer): is this a gradual accumulation (silt) or repeated allocation spikes?
sam (runtime): it's silt-like: small unreachable fragments in KV pages that compaction sometimes misses because they're below threshold. we need a more aggressive sweep policy for paged-attn allocator.
lee (oncall): short mitigation steps: 1) increase periodic full-compaction frequency to 5m for this pool, 2) lower max_sequence for large models on these nodes to reduce KV growth, 3) cordon the worst pod and restart to clear resident state if compaction doesn't stabilize.
infra-bot: increasing compaction cron for pa-usw2-3 via config override -> applied.
lee (oncall): applying temporary routing rule to shift 20% traffic off pa-usw2-3 to pa-usw2-5 (warm spare). rolling out now.
ops-manager: pinging affected customers with a heads-up; also logging incident in PagerDuty.
maria (engineer): could quantization or cache pre-warming be causing more small page allocations? any recent model rollouts?
sam (runtime): no model pushes in the last 24h to that pool. suspect allocator heuristic entropy with some sequences producing many short KV inserts. putting together a reproducer.
lee (oncall): alert suppressed for 30m while we watch. if resident growth crosses +15% in 10m, auto-evict to burst tier and create SEV.
lee (oncall): after routing shift and compaction, serving-42 memory stable for 12m; still one node (serving-47) showing slow creep.
sam (runtime): I initiated a graceful restart on serving-47 to clear stale resident pages. restarting now.
lee (oncall): restart complete. logs show epoch restart but no immediate crash. resident mem dropped ~420MB.
maria (engineer): nice. let's record the slab histograms pre/post for postmortem.
lee (oncall): pulled histograms: ```
pre: slab_buckets=[512MB:2,256MB:5,64MB:120,16MB:980] fragmentation_idx=0.76
post: slab_buckets=[512MB:1,256MB:4,64MB:30,16MB:150] fragmentation_idx=0.28
```
ops-manager: customer impact summary for status page: brief degradation for small subset (acct-237) with <0.3% request failure; no data loss.
lee (oncall): I'm going to hand off to night oncall in 40m. note: compaction cron remains at 5m for pa-usw2-3, watch for CPU jitter. if we see CUDA errors resume, escalate to SEV.
sam (runtime): follow-up action items: (A) implement low-threshold compaction for small fragments, (B) add KV slab leak detector alert (rate of small-region growth), (C) tune allocator to prefer larger region coalescing.
maria (engineer): I'll take (A) and (C). opening a tracker: RDW-3618.
ops-manager: please add customer communication template to the ticket.
lee (oncall): Handoff note: state=stabilized, mitigations applied (routing shift, compaction cron, one pod restart), next_steps=monitor for 2h, escalate if trend >+15%/10m.
lee (oncall): @night-oncall you'll see a suppressed alert rule but please verify manual metrics. passing to maria for eng follow-up. :white_check_mark:
